months.title: Month 10

months.letter:
Happy monthsary, Mi.

This month has been a lot. I don't always think rationally, but having you around that day helps me reframe the situation. Not every day is a perfect day, but it's good enough, and it's nice to be with you.

I've realized over the past month how much I trust you and how I rely on you when things get complicated. Not too much, though, because I still do that. But I appreciate it when we don't have to say too much to each other, even when we don't know exactly what happened. 

Another month with you, Mi. Happy monthsary. I'm glad we have this. I'm glad we have this not so much stable but we are still figuring it out month by month. :>

changes: Introduced a dedicated patch notes timeline with a polished modal layout.
Added a header shortcut to quickly open the latest release highlights.
Smoothed animations and readability for update details.
notes.title: Timeline-inspired patch notes

changes: Capsules now unlock sequentially so each month opens only after the previous one is unlocked.
Progress marker tooltips hide details for months that are still locked to avoid spoilers.
Direct access to locked capsules is blocked until prerequisite months are opened.
notes.title: Sequential Unlock Logic & Spoiler-Safe Tooltips

changes: Admin Settings tab now groups fields by branding, homepage copy, confetti palette, and CTA content for quicker edits.
Capsule editing form organizes basics, story content, media references, and optional links into labeled sections with helper text.
Contribution form groups donor basics, story, and media/link inputs to make submissions easier to understand.
notes.title: Admin UI form grouping improvements

changes: Progress markers now show the month’s song title in the tooltip.
Capsule view adds minimal prev/next buttons on the sides for quick month hopping.
notes.title: Capsule navigation & song titles

changes: Fixed and refined the Patch Notes modal design for improved layout consistency, spacing, and readability.
Improved visual hierarchy in the modal to clearly distinguish versions, dates, and change lists.
Connected website data to Firebase for centralized, real-time data storage and retrieval.
Replaced static/local data sources with Firebase-backed content to improve data reliability and maintainability.
notes.title: Patch Notes Modal UI Fix & Firebase Integration
